programs.title: If We Built It Today
programs.desc: Machu Picchu is one of the greatest landmarks of world architecture, yet the purpose of its construction and how it was built still remains a mystery; experts use cutting-edge engineering to reveal what it would take to rebuild this legendary city.

programs.title: If We Built It Today
programs.desc: The Hoover Dam was America's biggest build; its epic construction brought thousands to the wild, Wild West, creating a desert oasis of opportunity during the darkest decade of the 20th century.

programs.title: If We Built It Today
programs.desc: The Parthenon is the crowning jewel of ancient Greek architecture and it was engineered according to a mysterious mathematical formula; expert builders examine the secrets of its design and investigate if modern-day methods could rebuilt it.
